q1_issues.issue: "around fires" is encoded as (Location sk_tell_1 fire), folding a non-containment preposition into Location and leaving two Location atoms on one event; the surface preposition should head the oblique (Around <event> ...), as the instruction set's own Beside example does, and the same atom recurs inside the distribution rule (statement 10).

notes: The dual emission (group event plus per-member distribution rule at 1.0/0.9), the harbor_square genus without a noun-modifier genus, and the named time (Time ... lantern_night) with its Name atom are all correct. A smaller open question is whether Lantern-night should also carry the type atom licensed by the kind word inside the name.
